evidence.irr: 『software support agreements and related relationships represent the underlying relationships and agreements with customers of the acquired company's installed base』→据付基盤への埋込みで移行摩擦高い→70
evidence.rep: 『rapidly changing and characterized by intense competition, disruptive technology developments, evolving distribution models and increasingly lower barriers to entry』→参入障壁低下をPTC自身がリスク開示→複製困難だが唯一無二とは言えず保守60
evidence.dur: 同installed base/support agreements→CAD/PLMが顧客の設計ワークフローに埋込むスイッチングコスト→75
evidence.erosion: 同『disruptive technology developments and increasingly lower barriers to entry』(自社リスク開示)→emerging
evidence.disrupt: 蝕セクション キーワードヒットなし。堀の『disruptive technology developments』のみで存亡的脅威は未確立→unsettled
evidence.expiry: 限セクション ヒットなし。ソフトウェア業でコンセッション/特許束の期限依存なし→no
evidence.geopol: 『Approximately 50% of our revenue and 35% of our expenses were transacted in currencies other than the U.S. Dollar』→為替/国際分散で中程度。『No individual customer comprised more than 10% of...revenue for the years ended September 30, 2025, 2024 or 2023』→顧客集中懸念なし→1(中)
evidence.moatdecay: 売上5年CAGR13.4%・opm25.6→35.9%・のれん込みROIC回復(8.3→16.9%)→堀は維持→no
evidence.p1: のれん込みROIC5年σ=3.2pt(<6pt)→80。FY2025単年の16.9%上振れが変動の大半
evidence.p2: COVID期(FY2020)営利63.0→210.9M・売上増でドローダウンなし=浅い。ただしサブスク移行(ratable認識)が耐性を過大に見せる+観測は単一不況→95から減じ85
evidence.p4: accr=-2.0%(<0)+material weakness/unresolved staff commentsは監査定型文/目次で実指摘なし→90
evidence.f1: ROIIC(FY2023→25)=ΔNOPAT445.5/ΔIC314.5≈142%(NOPAT2023約338M→2025約784M、IC4,085→4,400、有形再投資軽微)≫WACC+15→90。FY2025 opm35.9%への段差の持続性に留保
evidence.f2: hitsにTAM/浸透率の数値なし→保守側65+注記
evidence.f3: 売上13.4%CAGRでシェア維持=片方+、R&D/売上系列はhits/XBRL未取得で符号不明、顧客集中>10%なし(-10不適用)→75
evidence.f4: 隣接(IoT/ThingWorx・SaaS/Onshape・ALM/Codebeamer)をM&Aで構築もセグメント別売上5%超の証拠hitsになし→育成中60
